chapters.reason: The paper explicitly proposes an architecture that mimics Chain-of-Thought via token-wise variable depth and iterative re-application of the model, which aligns with layer-recurrent execution.
The paper introduces a compute-adaptive model that dynamically allocates compute to tokens, effectively adjusting reasoning effort based on token needs.
The approach focuses on modifying the internal computation flow of the Transformer layers to achieve CoT-like performance without explicit text-based CoT generation.
